messages:
elaine: Quick sync — HarborCorp private rollout is on for next Wed (03/25) per customer. Major outstanding items: network cert chain, airgap image sync, and final L7 ACLs. Can owners call out blockers?

mike: I need the CSR from HarborCorp (they promised it last week). Pinged their infra contact just now, @harbor-infra. ETA?

andrea: Image sync is flaking — the registry sync job fails with 401 after ~30m. Looks like the proxy token used by the sync runner expired. Investigating with eng-infra.

seb: @andrea can you paste the error? I can try re-running the sync container once token is rotated.

andrea: Error snippet: ```
ERROR: failed to pull manifest for harborcorp/redis:6.2.9: unauthorized: authentication required
at sync_runner.go:142
```

raj: Certs: HarborCorp sent a CSR but it's missing the intermediate chain. Told them to re-submit full chain (leaf + intermediates). If they don't by EOD tomorrow we won't get the certs into vault in time.

nora: On L7 ACLs — I reviewed the proposed ACLs with security. One ask: we need explicit egress to artifact mirror IPs (10.14.200.0/24) from the airgap gateway. Anyone owning firewall rules? @mike or @seb?

mike: I can do the firewall rule change, but need exact CIDRs and port list. Nora, can you paste the final list?

nora: Final egress: 10.14.200.0/24 TCP 443, 9418 (git), and 5000 (registry). Also UDP 123 for NTP.

seb: Noted. I'll schedule a brief window to push the NAT rules tonight (low traffic window 02:00-02:30 UTC).

elaine: Thanks. Ops question: is there a fallback plan if certs don't land? We discussed temporary hostname mapping to our internal certs last week — still viable?

raj: We can use internal certs but HarborCorp's security team may reject it. As a short-lived fallback (<=24h) it's OK for validation tests only, not for GA.

andrea: If image sync still fails after token rotation, backup plan is to export images to tar and SCP to bastion: ```
ssh ops-bastion@harbor-bastion
scp /tmp/harbor-images.tar.gz harbor-bastion:/var/lib/images/
```

seb: I'll prep that path and leave a small helper script on the bastion.

deploy-bot: pipeline/harborcorp-canary queued by nora — stage: canary-deploy (waiting on artifact availability).

mike: Quick ask for timelines: if we get CSR+chain by tomorrow EOD and token fixed today, we can do canary Mon (03/23) and prod Wed (03/25). If CSR slips >24h, plan slides by at least one week.

elaine: Solid. Action items: (1) Raj — confirm CSR chain status with HarborCorp (owner). (2) Andrea/eng-infra — rotate proxy token + validate registry sync (owner). (3) Mike/Seb — push egress/NAT rules and prep bastion fallback (owner). (4) Nora — hold canary pipeline until artifacts confirmed.

nora: I'll gate the canary and post a go/no-go by Mon 09:00 PT. :thumbsup:

raj: Re: CSR — just got a reply from HarborCorp; they re-uploaded with intermediates and certs look OK. Sending to vault now.

andrea: Token rotated, re-run sync — currently ~60% complete, no auth errors so far.

seb: NAT rules pushed to pre-prod and bastion script staged.

elaine: This is great — thanks everyone. We'll keep this thread for async updates. If anything blocks the EOD token/CSR window, ping here and we re-evaluate timeline. :eyes:
